$comment: The curated development dataset of dev.orochia.com (npm run dev:dataset). Fictional creators, one niche each, titles that say what the footage shows. Every clip is made by Orazaka (its run id is read from the media folder's manifest.json at seed time and written in the video's description); nothing here is a real person, and the clips show no face. More creators = more entries here, each with its own QA credentials (key names of the QA env file).

creators.bio: Night sessions: live jazz, rainy city streets and fires with a guitar. New clip every week.
Kitchen, trails and the workshop: what I cook, where I walk, what I make with my hands.
Trails, harbours and deserts: slow travel, filmed where the signal ends.
Strength and mobility, five minutes at a time, before the city wakes up.
Ink, paint and walls: process clips from a Montreal studio.

generate.$comment: Prompts of the vertical clips (Wan 2.1 1.3B, 480x832, through Orazaka's video-generation Studio): no face, no text, SFW.

clips.vinyl-spin.mp4: A vinyl record spinning on a turntable, close-up of the needle in the groove, warm side light, shallow depth of field, cinematic. No people, no faces, no text.
clips.neon-alley.mp4: A pink neon sign flickering above a narrow rainy alley, wet cobblestones reflecting the glow, steam rising, slow push-in, cinematic. No people, no faces, no lettering.
clips.dj-hands.mp4: Close-up of hands sliding the faders of a DJ mixer, coloured stage lights pulsing in the background, shallow depth of field. Hands only, no faces, no text.
clips.latte-pour.mp4: Top-down view of milk being poured into an espresso cup forming a leaf pattern, soft daylight on a wooden table, slow motion. Hands not visible, no faces, no text.
clips.pottery-wheel.mp4: A lump of wet clay spinning on a potter's wheel while two hands shape it into a bowl, warm workshop light, close-up. Hands only, no faces, no text.
clips.waterfall-forest.mp4: A waterfall in a green forest, camera tilting down from the crest to the misty pool, moss on the rocks, soft light through the trees. No people, no text.
clips.desert-dunes.mp4: Sand streaming off a desert dune ridge at golden hour, wind lifting grains, slow push along the crest, warm light. No people, no faces, no text.
clips.kettlebell-dawn.mp4: A kettlebell swinging in an arc against a pale orange sunrise, strong backlight, only a dark silhouette of hands and the bell. No faces, no text.
clips.trail-run.mp4: Low camera on a forest trail, running shoes hitting a leafy path, sunlight flickering through trees, motion blur. Feet only, no faces, no text.
clips.stretch-mat.mp4: A yoga mat on a wooden floor with a window's sunlight stripe, a slow stretching sequence shown by bare hands and feet only. No faces, no text.
clips.painting-brush.mp4: Macro of a brush loaded with thick violet paint dragging a stroke across canvas, shallow depth of field, studio light. No people, no faces, no text.
clips.ink-wash.mp4: Black ink blooming into wet paper in soft clouds, top-down macro, slow motion. No people, no faces, no text.
clips.sketchbook.mp4: A thumb flipping the pages of a sketchbook filled with pencil studies of plants and hands, desk light. Hands only, no faces, no text.
clips.mural-wall.mp4: A brick wall painted with colour blocks and geometric shapes in violet, coral and gold, camera slowly rising in morning light. No people, no faces, no lettering.
